sections.body: Write a program that reads an integer and prints "Special Eleven" when the remainder after dividing it by 11 is 0 or 1, otherwise "Normal Number".

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It tests N % 11 == 0 or N % 11 == 1 and prints one of two fixed messages.
